rules.description: Checks that deleted records do not exceed 0.1%.
Verifies that the overall dataset reaches recent reporting years (>= 2024).

params.query: SELECT MAX(MaxDate) >= '2024' AS is_fresh, COUNT(*) AS row_cnt FROM stats

rules.description: Verify all active StatVars meet the minimum historical boundary (>= 2009).

params.query: SELECT StatVar, MaxDate, COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_svs FROM stats
